transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. —. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I need help dealing with the people who are constantly monitoring me. They have been tracking my every move and are actively trying to harm me, and I need someone to make them stop.
Have you also had any periods of unusually high energy or feeling very depressed, and if so, did those mood changes happen at the same time as the suspicious beliefs or at other times?

No, I haven't really had any periods of unusually high energy or deep depression. My mood has been pretty stable, other than just feeling constantly anxious and worried about the people who are watching me.
Have you noticed hearing voices, seeing things others don’t, or having trouble with your thoughts or speech becoming confused or hard to follow?
No, I don't hear any voices or see things that aren't actually there. My mind is perfectly clear, and I don't have any trouble speaking or keeping my thoughts organized.

This pattern is more consistent with Delusional Disorder.
